title: SewCraft
description: A tech modpack centered around Create +addons, Farmers Delight +addons, and Diagetics.
body:
SewCraft is a tech-focused modpack. It mainly focuses on Create 6 +compat mods, ComputerCraft +compat mods, FarmerDelight +addons, and other tech and QOL mods. This is a modpack for tinkerers like me.

This is essentially vanilla Minecraft with QOL improvements, tons of Create and Create compatibility mods, and a few additions to vanilla mobs to make exploration more engaging. The pack also includes immersive armors, better combat, and a few weapon expansions to keep combat from being stale.
